scope: Paired NXR UDP encoder-only diagnostic; not production package throughput or full association acceptance.

allocationCases.scope: Diagnostic allocation attribution of unchanged canonical NXR UDP frame writer. Not an end-to-end, latency, throughput or release acceptance result. No product source change.
allocationCases.hypothesis: After caller buffer warmup, body and optional destination scratch vectors allocate on every frame. Heaptrack slope and stacks must substantiate this before considering optimization.
allocationCases.criterion: For each case subtract matched zero-iteration startup call count; inspect allocation backtraces to attribute incremental calls. No timing claims from instrumentation. No acceptance threshold or product optimization inferred from static source alone.

cpuComparison.cpu: Child user+system CPU via getrusage; balanced per-block arithmetic mean ratio candidate/baseline
cpuComparison.interval: 10000 deterministic bootstrap resamples of 20 block ratios, median 95% percentile interval
cpuComparison.guard: All 15 upper CPU ratios <=1.05; crossing is unresolved and requires investigation. Allocation savings must repeat all 15 cases. No favorable early stop or pooling. Full product/release gates remain independently required.
cpuComparison.host: P-core policies 0..7 fixed 2.4 GHz, child affinity CPU2; no local compilation or archive verification; restore exact previous CPU policy on all exits.
